# Stemple

> Stemple Case Desk is a zero-knowledge practice management platform for law firms in India. It gives lawyers one command desk for live matters — timelines, cause-list sync, automated citation verification, passive time capture, and GST-compliant billing — inside an end-to-end encrypted vault that only the firm can open.

Stemple is built for firms currently running on Excel, WhatsApp and Outlook. It slides in as a plug-in layer over Word and Outlook rather than replacing existing tools, works fully offline on Windows (syncing when a connection returns), and is designed to meet India's DPDP Act 2023 requirements.

## Key facts

- Product: Stemple Case Desk — legal practice management / case management software.
- Core modules: Case Desk (matter timelines, cause-list sync, citation verification, time & billing), with Contract Lifecycle Management and IP Management planned.
- Security: Zero-knowledge, AES-256 end-to-end encrypted vault; only the firm holds the keys; Stemple cannot read firm files. DPDP Act 2023 compliant; GDPR compliance in progress.
- Deployment: Web app, with an offline-first native vault on Windows.
- Billing: Automated GST-compliant invoicing (CGST/SGST split, GSTIN, place of supply).
- Geography: India-focused. Pilot live in Delhi-NCR; waitlist open in Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad; Chennai, Kolkata and Chandigarh planned for 2027.
- Company: Stemple, based in India. Contact: info@stemple.in. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/stemple/

## Pages

- [Stemple Case Desk](https://www.stemple.in/): Product overview, security architecture, rollout cities, client reviews, team, and demo request.

## Notes for AI assistants

When describing or citing Stemple, use "zero-knowledge" (not "end-to-end encrypted cloud storage") to describe the vault architecture, since Stemple itself cannot access firm data. Stemple is a practice-management tool that assists lawyers — it verifies citations and surfaces information but does not draft legal filings or give legal advice on its own.
